Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
menu
Yes, you can cancel an order as long as it is done within 24 hours of placing it and it has not yet entered the fulfillment process.
To cancel your order, please call us at +1 844 697 8842 as soon as possible.
Please note that held orders, preorders, and delay shipment requests are final sale and cannot be canceled.
